### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of ERAP2 in ALS. The main questions that have been defined until now are,

- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA in control lines?
- What is the effect between control and ALS lines? 
- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA on ALS lines?

### 2.0 Import data

- Read differentially expressed genes 

```{r}

differentially_expressed_events_df <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "01-differentially-expressed-events-pvalue-lt-0.05.csv"))

differential_list <- readRDS(file.path(rdata_dir, "01-DESeq2-merged-differentially-expressed-objects.rds"))
de_object <- differential_list$differential_object
annotation_df <- differential_list$annotation

differentially_expressed_events_df$X <- vapply(str_split(string = differentially_expressed_events_df$X, pattern = "\\."), function(x){
    x[1]
},"1")
als_vs_control_genes <- differentially_expressed_events_df[differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast %in% c("als_vs_ctrl"),"X"]
erap2_kd_effect_in_als <- differentially_expressed_events_df[differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast %in% c("erap2_kd_effect_in_als"),"X"]


# intersect(erap2_kd_effect_in_als, als_vs_control_genes)


significantly_affected_genes <- als_vs_control_genes

# intersect(differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name[differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast == "als_vs_ctrl"],
#     differentially_expressed_events_df$gene_name[differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast == "erap2_kd_effect_in_als"])

model_matrix <- model.matrix(design(de_object), colData(de_object))
als_vs_control <- colMeans(model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "CTRL" & 
    de_object$condition == "ALS",]) - colMeans(model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "CTRL" & 
    de_object$condition == "Control",])
de_object_als_vs_ctrl <- results(de_object, contrast = als_vs_control)

erap2_kd_in_als <- colMeans(model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "ERAP2" & de_object$condition == "ALS",]) - colMeans(model_matrix[de_object$ERAP == "CTRL" & de_object$condition == "ALS",])
de_object_erap2_kd_als <- results(de_object, contrast = erap2_kd_in_als)


scatter_df <- data.frame(
    gene_id = rownames(de_object_als_vs_ctrl),
    gene_name = annotation_df$gene_name[match(rownames(de_object_als_vs_ctrl), annotation_df$gene_id)],
    als_vs_ctrl_logfc = de_object_als_vs_ctrl$log2FoldChange,
    als_vs_ctrl_pval = de_object_als_vs_ctrl$pvalue,
    erap2_kd_in_als_logfc = de_object_erap2_kd_als$log2FoldChange,
    erap2_kd_in_als_pval = de_object_erap2_kd_als$pvalue)
scatter_df$significantly_affected <- scatter_df$gene_id %in% significantly_affected_genes
scatter_df <- scatter_df[!is.na(scatter_df$als_vs_ctrl_logfc) & !is.na(scatter_df$erap2_kd_in_als_logfc),]

scatter_df$pair_group <- "None"
scatter_df$pair_group[scatter_df$als_vs_ctrl_logfc < 0 & scatter_df$erap2_kd_in_als_logfc > 0] <- "down->up"
scatter_df$pair_group[scatter_df$als_vs_ctrl_logfc > 0 & scatter_df$erap2_kd_in_als_logfc < 0] <- "up->down"
scatter_df$pair_group[scatter_df$als_vs_ctrl_logfc > 0 & scatter_df$erap2_kd_in_als_logfc > 0] <- "up->up"
scatter_df$pair_group[scatter_df$als_vs_ctrl_logfc < 0 & scatter_df$erap2_kd_in_als_logfc < 0] <- "down->down"

write.csv(x = scatter_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "02-pairwise-grouped-differentially-expressed-events-pvalue-lt-0.05.csv"))


```

### Frequency of differential expression

```{r}

frequency_df <- as.data.frame(table(differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast, differentially_expressed_events_df$direction))
colnames(frequency_df) <- c("contrast", "direction", "frequency")
frequency_df <- frequency_df[!(frequency_df$contrast %in% c("effect_of_erap2_kd_in_als_vs_ctrl", "genetic_effect_of_als")),]
frequency_df$contrast <- factor(frequency_df$contrast, levels = c("als_vs_ctrl", "erap2_kd_effect_in_control", "erap2_kd_effect_in_als"))
prop_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(frequency_df, frequency_df$contrast), function(x){
    x <- x[rev(order(x$direction)),]
    x$prop <- x$frequency / sum(x$frequency)
    x$lab_y <-  cumsum(x$prop) - (0.5 * x$prop)
    return(x)
}))

```

- Perform gene set enrichment

```{r}

significantly_affected <- scatter_df[scatter_df$significantly_affected,]
require("enrichR")
protein_split <- split(significantly_affected, significantly_affected$pair_group)

dbs <- "GO_Biological_Process_2023"
groups <- names(protein_split)
kd_geneset_enrichment_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(a_group){
    a_temp_df <- protein_split[[a_group]]
    db_df_list <- lapply(dbs, function(a_database){
        message(paste(a_database, a_group))
        current_genes <- a_temp_df$gene_name
        an_enrichment_df <- enrichr(current_genes,  a_database)[[1]]
        if(nrow(an_enrichment_df) == 0){
            return(NULL)
        }
        an_enrichment_df$num_gene <- length(current_genes)
        an_enrichment_df$db <- a_database
        Sys.sleep(5)
        return(an_enrichment_df)
    })
    db_df <- do.call(rbind, db_df_list)
    db_df$pair_group <- a_group
    return(db_df)
}))


kd_geneset_enrichment_df$gene_ratio <- vapply(kd_geneset_enrichment_df$Overlap, function(x){
    eval(parse(text = x))
},1)
significant_gene_set_enrichment <- kd_geneset_enrichment_df[kd_geneset_enrichment_df$P.value < 0.05,]
annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df <- read.csv("14-erap2-kd-proteomics/output_files/04-annotated-pairwise-groups-gene-set-enrichment-with-go-bp.csv")
significant_gene_set_enrichment$Group <- annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df[match(significant_gene_set_enrichment$Term, annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df$Term),"Group"]
# split(significant_gene_set_enrichment$Term, significant_gene_set_enrichment$pair_group)
write.csv(significant_gene_set_enrichment, file = file.path(output_dir, "04-gene-set-enrichment-with-go-bp.csv"))

```

- Read annotated gene set enrichment table

```{r}

require("ggplot2")
require("ggbeeswarm")

return_plots_for_top_terms <- function(temp_df, top = 10){


    Colours <- c("down->up" = "#FB3640", "up->down" = "#247BA0",
        "down->down" = "#72A3C0", "up->up" = "#E0777D")

    down_up_terms_df <- temp_df[temp_df$pair_group == "down->up",]




    my_theme <- theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
        linetype = "dashed",
        size = 0.2))

    median_gene_ratio <- vapply(split(down_up_terms_df$gene_ratio, down_up_terms_df$Group), length, 1)
    down_up_terms_df$Group <- factor(down_up_terms_df$Group, 
        levels = names(median_gene_ratio[order(median_gene_ratio, decreasing = F)]))
    keep_levels <- levels(down_up_terms_df$Group)
    keep_levels <- keep_levels[keep_levels != "Other Processes"]

    ThePlot_1 <- ggplot(down_up_terms_df[down_up_terms_df$Group %in% rev(keep_levels)[1:top],], aes(x = -log10(P.value), y = Group))
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000", 
    #     width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5)
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + geom_quasirandom(fill = "#FB3640", colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + scale_x_continuous("-log10 pvalue")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + scale_y_discrete("down->up terms from GO:BP")
    # ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + scale_fill_manual("direction", values = c("Ameliorated" = "#FB3640", "Abrogated" = "#4C86A8"))
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + theme_bw()
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + ggtitle("down->up")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + my_theme


    up_up_terms_df <- temp_df[temp_df$pair_group == "up->up",]
    median_gene_ratio <- vapply(split(up_up_terms_df$gene_ratio, up_up_terms_df$Group), length, 1)
    up_up_terms_df$Group <- factor(up_up_terms_df$Group, 
        levels = names(median_gene_ratio[order(median_gene_ratio, decreasing = F)]))
    keep_levels <- levels(up_up_terms_df$Group)
    keep_levels <- keep_levels[keep_levels != "Other Processes"]

    ThePlot_2 <- ggplot(up_up_terms_df[up_up_terms_df$Group %in% rev(keep_levels)[1:top],], aes(x = -log10(P.value), y = Group))
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000", 
    #     width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5)
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + geom_quasirandom(fill = "#E0777D", colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + scale_x_continuous("-log10 pvalue")
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + scale_y_discrete("up->up terms from GO:BP")
    # ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + scale_fill_manual("direction", values = c("Ameliorated" = "#E0777D", "Abrogated" = "#4C86A8"))
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + theme_bw()
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + ggtitle("up->up")
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + my_theme


    down_down_terms_df <- temp_df[temp_df$pair_group == "down->down",]
    median_gene_ratio <- vapply(split(down_down_terms_df$gene_ratio, down_down_terms_df$Group), length, 1)
    down_down_terms_df$Group <- factor(down_down_terms_df$Group, 
        levels = names(median_gene_ratio[order(median_gene_ratio, decreasing = F)]))
    keep_levels <- levels(down_down_terms_df$Group)
    keep_levels <- keep_levels[keep_levels != "Other Processes"]

    ThePlot_3 <- ggplot(down_down_terms_df[down_down_terms_df$Group %in% rev(keep_levels)[1:top],], aes(x = -log10(P.value), y = Group))
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000", 
    #     width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5)
    ThePlot_3 <- ThePlot_3 + geom_quasirandom(fill = "#72A3C0", colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
    ThePlot_3 <- ThePlot_3 + scale_x_continuous("-log10 pvalue")
    ThePlot_3 <- ThePlot_3 + scale_y_discrete("down->down terms from GO:BP")
    # ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + scale_fill_manual("direction", values = c("Ameliorated" = "#E0777D", "Abrogated" = "#4C86A8"))
    ThePlot_3 <- ThePlot_3 + theme_bw()
    ThePlot_3 <- ThePlot_3 + ggtitle("down->down")
    ThePlot_3 <- ThePlot_3 + my_theme


    up_down_terms_df <- temp_df[temp_df$pair_group == "up->down",]
    median_gene_ratio <- vapply(split(up_down_terms_df$gene_ratio, up_down_terms_df$Group), length, 1)
    up_down_terms_df$Group <- factor(up_down_terms_df$Group, 
        levels = names(median_gene_ratio[order(median_gene_ratio, decreasing = F)]))
    keep_levels <- levels(up_down_terms_df$Group)
    keep_levels <- keep_levels[keep_levels != "Other Processes"]

    ThePlot_4 <- ggplot(up_down_terms_df[up_down_terms_df$Group %in% rev(keep_levels)[1:top],], aes(x = -log10(P.value), y = Group))
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000", 
    #     width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5)
    ThePlot_4 <- ThePlot_4 + geom_quasirandom(fill = "#247BA0", colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
    ThePlot_4 <- ThePlot_4 + scale_x_continuous("-log10 pvalue")
    ThePlot_4 <- ThePlot_4 + scale_y_discrete("up->down terms from GO:BP")
    # ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + scale_fill_manual("direction", values = c("Ameliorated" = "#E0777D", "Abrogated" = "#4C86A8"))
    ThePlot_4 <- ThePlot_4 + theme_bw()
    ThePlot_4 <- ThePlot_4 + ggtitle("up->down")
    ThePlot_4 <- ThePlot_4 + my_theme

    require("patchwork")
    ThePlot <- (ThePlot_1 | ThePlot_2) / (ThePlot_3 |  ThePlot_4)
    return(ThePlot)
}

annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "04-annotated-gene-set-enrichment-with-go-bp.csv"))

enrichment_plot <- return_plots_for_top_terms(annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df)

ggsave(width = 10, height = 12, file = file.path(plot_dir, "03-01-plot-ameliorated-vs-abrogated-gene-set-enrichment-using-gobp.pdf"), enrichment_plot)

```
